This page implements the pinned legacy `4A_clean_clinic_diagnosis.R` at
commit `31e0769683e133e136b09ac0c6608c5a12657a9a`. Scientific rules and ambiguous
edge cases retain legacy behavior. Measurement tables remain in DuckDB and
tracked Parquet files; only rules, schemas, and aggregate audits enter R.
The execution page owns dynamic branches. No nested futures or Slurm setup is
introduced here.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require The Identity And Dictionary Products"}

Require pages 18–21: the prepared W3 Parquet, clinic-ID Parquet, monthly source
archive/selectors, and diagnosis dictionary with its recorded W3 schema.
S4 validates those dictionary rules as a dependency before interpreting them.
This page stays unevaluated during rendering.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare Disk And SQL Helpers"}

SQL uses quoted identifiers and literals, never unrestricted R evaluation.
DuckDB owns joins, reductions, and projection. Helpers return paths and clean
up their temporary tables even after an error. CSV extraction remains private
to the branch. CP1252 decoding reuses the official encodings extension.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn <- function(x) {
  paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", x, fixed = TRUE), "'")
}
s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn <- function(x) {
  paste0('"', gsub('"', '""', x, fixed = TRUE), '"')
}
s4a_diagnosis_query_fn <- function(sql) {
  duckplyr::read_sql_duckdb(sql, prudence = "stingy")
}
s4a_diagnosis_read_fn <- function(paths) {
  stopifnot(length(paths) > 0L, all(file.exists(paths)))
  paste0("read_parquet([", paste(s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(paths), collapse = ","),
         "], union_by_name = true)")
}
s4a_diagnosis_write_fn <- function(sql, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  duckplyr::compute_parquet(s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(sql), path)
  path
}
s4a_diagnosis_table_fn <- function(name, sql) {
  duckplyr::db_exec(paste0("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE ", name, " AS ", sql))
  name
}
s4a_diagnosis_cleanup_fn <- function(names) {
  for (name in names) duckplyr::db_exec(paste("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS", name))
}
s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn <- function(sql) {
  names(s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0("SELECT * FROM (", sql, ") LIMIT 0")))
}
s4a_diagnosis_csv_fn <- function(path, encoding = "CP1252") {
  if (encoding == "CP1252") {
    duckplyr::db_exec("INSTALL encodings")
    duckplyr::db_exec("LOAD encodings")
  }
  paste0("read_csv(", s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(path),
         ", header=true, delim=',', quote='\"', escape='\"', nullstr='NA', ",
         "all_varchar=true, encoding=", s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(encoding), ")")
}
s4a_diagnosis_tall_fn <- function(sql, source) {
  paste0("SELECT cNom, CAST(nullif(cAnnee,'') AS INTEGER) cAnnee, ",
    "CAST(nullif(cPeriode,'') AS INTEGER) cPeriode, ",
    "CAST(CAST(nullif(cCodeNiv,'') AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) cCodeNiv, ",
    "CAST(CAST(nullif(cCodeStru,'') AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) cCodeStru, ",
    "CAST(nullif(fname,'') AS INTEGER) fname, cCode, Variable, ",
    "CAST(nullif(Value,'') AS DOUBLE) AS \"Value\", row_number() OVER () source_row, ",
    s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(source), " source_file FROM ", sql)
}
s4a_diagnosis_drop_na_if_fn <- function(x) {
  values <- unique(stats::na.omit(x))
  if (length(values)) values else NA_integer_
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Validate And Compile Dictionary Rules"}

The grammar is one exact source term or terms separated by ` + `. Missing
expressions produce numeric missing values. All harmonized measurements use
a numeric Parquet schema, including columns R would infer as all-NA logical. Direct terms preserve sentinels;
earlier-wave sums replace only `-1`, while W3 sums replace missing components.
Repeated summands and unknown terms fail through the existing S3 validator.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_rules_fn <- function(dictionary, schema, wave12) {
  issues <- s3_diagnosis_validate_fn(dictionary, schema, wave12)
  if (nrow(issues)) stop("S4 dictionary validation failed: ", paste(capture.output(print(issues)), collapse = "\n"))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dictionary$var), all(grepl("^V[0-9]+$", dictionary$var)))
  rules <- purrr::map_dfr(c("wave1", "wave2", "wave3A", "wave3B"), function(wave) {
    source_expressions <- dictionary[[paste0(wave, "_colname")]]
    tibble::tibble(wave = wave, var = dictionary$var, filename = dictionary$filename,
                   expression = source_expressions)
  })
  rules$terms <- lapply(rules$expression, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) character() else strsplit(x, " + ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  })
  if (any(vapply(rules$terms, function(x) any(!nzchar(x)), logical(1)))) stop("Empty source term")
  rules
}
s4a_diagnosis_expression_fn <- function(terms, wave) {
  if (!length(terms)) return("CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)")
  quoted <- s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(terms)
  if (length(terms) == 1L) return(quoted)
  parts <- if (wave %in% c("wave1", "wave2")) {
    paste0("CASE WHEN ", quoted, " = -1 THEN 0 ELSE ", quoted, " END")
  } else paste0("coalesce(", quoted, ", 0)")
  paste(parts, collapse = " + ")
}
s4a_diagnosis_evaluation_rules_df <- s4a_diagnosis_rules_fn(
  s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df, s3_w3_column_dictionary_df,
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::select(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df, Column.Name),
    dplyr::select(s3_diagnosis_supplementary_dictionary_df, Column.Name)
  )
)
s4a_diagnosis_wave12_expected_columns_df <- s4a_diagnosis_evaluation_rules_df |>
  dplyr::filter(wave %in% c("wave1", "wave2")) |>
  dplyr::select(wave, terms) |> tidyr::unnest_longer(terms) |> dplyr::distinct()
s4a_diagnosis_output_groups_chr <- unique(stats::na.omit(s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df$filename))
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Stage Supplement Measurements"}

AVC is selected by exact archive suffix; the other selectors reuse S3.
All measurement rows are retained. A complete byte scan of both staged
supplements found CP1252 bytes (including `9C`), matching the monthly inputs. Replacement Variable names use `cCode`
and the final underscore suffix, exactly as in the original script.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_supplement_members_chr <- c(
  AVC = s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, "data/raw/from_Kevin/mdg_tall_split/AVC.csv"),
  diar_pneu = s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["diar_pneu"]]
)
s4a_diagnosis_supplements_fn <- function(archive, members, path) {
  tables <- c("s4_avc", "s4_diar")
  on.exit(s4a_diagnosis_cleanup_fn(tables), add = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_along(members)) {
    s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(archive, members[[i]], function(csv) {
      s4a_diagnosis_table_fn(tables[[i]], s4a_diagnosis_tall_fn(
        s4a_diagnosis_csv_fn(csv), members[[i]]))
    })
  }
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("SELECT * FROM s4_avc UNION ALL SELECT * REPLACE ",
    "(cCode || regexp_replace(Variable, '^.*_', '_') AS Variable) FROM s4_diar"), path)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_diagnosis_wave12_supplements_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_supplements_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s4a_diagnosis_supplement_members_chr,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave12_supplements.parquet")
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Decode One Month And Join Identities"}

The monthly branch appends supplements, then reproduces `month_df[clinicID]`
with an identity-preserving join, including missing-key matches and inventory
multiplicity. Unmatched inventory rows have no measurements and fail the
positive-total reporting filter. Keeping that filter after the join preserves
its interaction with repeated identities. Provenance stays in the input file.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_month_input_fn <- function(archive, member, supplements, path) {
  year <- as.integer(substr(basename(member), 1, 4))
  month <- as.integer(substr(basename(member), 6, 7))
  s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(archive, member, function(csv) {
    sql <- paste0("SELECT * FROM (", s4a_diagnosis_tall_fn(s4a_diagnosis_csv_fn(csv), member),
      ") WHERE NOT (cCode IN ('DySS','DiSS','DiDy','P','PGRA') AND fname=1) ",
      "UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(supplements),
      " WHERE cAnnee=", year, " AND cPeriode=", month)
    s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(sql, path)
  })
}
s4a_diagnosis_join_fn <- function(input, identities) {
  keys <- c("cAnnee", "cPeriode", "cCodeNiv", "cCodeStru", "cNom", "fname")
  joins <- paste0("m.", keys, " IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.", keys, collapse = " AND ")
  paste0("WITH measured AS (SELECT * FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input),
    " WHERE Variable IS NOT NULL), joined AS (SELECT i.clinic_ID, ",
    paste0("i.", keys, collapse = ","), ", m.cCode, ",
    "replace(replace(replace(m.Variable, 'c$_', 'c__'), '_*', '__'), ",
    "'SOMME ACCTS', 'SOMME_ACCTS') AS \"Variable\", m.Value FROM ",
    s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(identities), " i LEFT JOIN measured m ON ", joins,
    " WHERE i.clinic_ID != 'qCHtCHkwqtQ') SELECT * FROM joined ",
    "QUALIFY sum(Value) OVER (PARTITION BY clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname)>0")
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Classify And Reduce Monthly Duplicates"}

Flags count missing as a distinct value, unlike SQL `count(DISTINCT)` alone.
Decisions use the wider cCode group and their original precedence. Reduction
then groups by Variable within each decision class, matching the four legacy
rbind inputs. Each branch returns a reduced file and an aggregate audit file.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_reduce_sql_fn <- function(sql) {
  keys <- "clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname"
  paste0("WITH joined AS (", sql, "), flags AS (SELECT *, ",
    "count(DISTINCT Value) OVER v > 1 dist_numeric, ",
    "(count(DISTINCT Value) OVER v + CASE WHEN count(*) OVER v > count(Value) OVER v THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>1 dist, ",
    "count(*) OVER v > 1 is_dup FROM joined WINDOW v AS (PARTITION BY ", keys,
    ",Variable)) SELECT *, CASE WHEN NOT bool_or(dist) OVER c THEN 'unique' ",
    "WHEN NOT bool_or(dist_numeric) OVER c THEN 'unique_nonNA' ",
    "WHEN bool_and(dist) OVER c THEN 'sum' ",
    "WHEN bool_and(dist) FILTER (WHERE is_dup) OVER c THEN 'sum2' ",
    "ELSE 'error' END decision FROM flags WINDOW c AS (PARTITION BY ", keys, ",cCode)")
}
s4a_diagnosis_reduce_fn <- function(input, identities, path) {
  on.exit(s4a_diagnosis_cleanup_fn("s4_flags"), add = TRUE)
  s4a_diagnosis_table_fn("s4_flags", s4a_diagnosis_reduce_sql_fn(s4a_diagnosis_join_fn(input, identities)))
  reduced <- s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0(
    "SELECT clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname,Variable, CASE ",
    "WHEN decision IN ('sum','sum2') THEN coalesce(sum(Value),0) ",
    "WHEN decision='error' THEN -99 ELSE max(Value) END AS \"Value\" ",
    "FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN decision='sum2' THEN 'sum' ELSE decision END AS decision) FROM s4_flags) GROUP BY clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname,Variable,decision"), path)
  audit <- s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0(
    "SELECT cAnnee,cPeriode,fname,decision,count(*) input_rows, ",
    "count(DISTINCT clinic_ID) clinics FROM s4_flags GROUP BY ALL"),
    sub("\\.parquet$", "_audit.parquet", path))
  c(reduced = reduced, audit = audit)
}
s4a_diagnosis_wave12_decision_audit_df <- {
  paths <- s4a_diagnosis_wave12_deduplicated_parquet
  paths <- paths[endsWith(paths, "_audit.parquet")]
  s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0("SELECT * FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(paths))) |> dplyr::collect()
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Map A Month Without Collecting Measurements"}

Only dictionary source terms are pivoted. The report universe is established
before projection, preserving reports whose mapped values are all missing.
Explicit missing tall values become -1; absent cells remain missing. A whole
wave subset with at most one tall row is skipped. If duplicate cells survive
the four legacy reductions, reproduce dcast's fallback to length (including
its zero fill) across that wave, rather than silently taking their maximum.
Collect only a per-wave summary of the row count, duplicate flag, and present
Variable names before generating the pivot. Repeating an `EXISTS` subquery
in every pivot column exceeds DuckDB's expression-depth limit at the wave 2
dictionary's 1,237 source terms. The summary also avoids a window aggregate
per column to distinguish globally absent variables from missing cells.
Use DuckDB's native `PIVOT` with an explicit term list so it can select its
implementation for wide tables; thousands of hand-written filtered
aggregates also consumed excessive memory in a two-row reproduction.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_mapping_audit_fn <- function(paths) {
  inputs <- paths[!endsWith(paths, "_audit.parquet")]
  source <- sub("union_by_name = true", "union_by_name = true, filename = true",
                s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(inputs), fixed = TRUE)
  s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0(
    "WITH cells AS (SELECT filename,cAnnee,cPeriode,CASE WHEN fname=1 THEN 'wave1' ELSE 'wave2' END wave,",
    "clinic_ID,fname,Variable,count(*) n FROM ", source,
    " WHERE fname>=1 GROUP BY ALL) SELECT filename,cAnnee,cPeriode,wave,",
    "sum(n) tall_rows,sum(n)<=1 skipped_one_row,bool_or(n>1) dcast_length_fallback ",
    "FROM cells GROUP BY ALL")) |> dplyr::collect()
}
s4a_diagnosis_wave12_mapping_audit_df <- s4a_diagnosis_mapping_audit_fn(
  s4a_diagnosis_wave12_deduplicated_parquet
)
s4a_diagnosis_month_map_fn <- function(paths, rules, path) {
  input <- paths[!endsWith(paths, "_audit.parquet")]
  queries <- lapply(c("wave1", "wave2"), function(wave) {
    r <- rules[rules$wave == wave, ]
    terms <- unique(unlist(r$terms))
    source <- paste0("SELECT * FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input),
                     if (wave == "wave1") " WHERE fname=1" else " WHERE fname>1")
    keys <- "clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname"
    stats <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0(
      "SELECT coalesce(sum(n),0) tall_rows, coalesce(bool_or(n>1),false) length_fallback, ",
      "list(DISTINCT Variable) present_terms FROM (SELECT Variable,count(*) n FROM (",
      source, ") GROUP BY ", keys, ",Variable)")) |> dplyr::collect()
    present <- stats$present_terms[[1L]]
    pivot <- if (length(terms)) paste0(
      "PIVOT src ON Variable IN (", paste(s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(terms),collapse=","), ") USING ",
      if (stats$length_fallback) "count(*)" else "max(coalesce(Value,-1))",
      " GROUP BY ", keys
    ) else paste0("SELECT ", keys, " FROM src GROUP BY ", keys)
    projection <- vapply(terms, function(term) {
      quoted <- s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(term)
      value <- if (!stats$length_fallback) quoted else if (term %in% present) {
        paste0("coalesce(CAST(", quoted, " AS DOUBLE),0::DOUBLE)")
      } else "CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)"
      paste0(value, " AS ", quoted)
    }, character(1))
    mapped <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(r)), function(i) paste0(
      s4a_diagnosis_expression_fn(r$terms[[i]], wave), " AS ",
      s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(r$var[[i]])), character(1))
    paste0("WITH src AS (", source, "), pivoted AS (", pivot, "), wide AS (SELECT ", keys,
      if (length(projection)) paste0(",", paste(projection, collapse = ",")),
      " FROM pivoted) SELECT ", keys, ",", paste(mapped, collapse = ","),
      " FROM wide WHERE ", if (stats$tall_rows>1) "true" else "false", " ORDER BY ", keys)
  })
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("(", queries[[1]], ") UNION ALL (", queries[[2]], ")"), path)
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Insert The Actual 2020 Anemia Measurements"}

The anemia schema from S3 does not contain measurements. Decode the source
CSV as UTF-8, repair question-mark headers, and remove the two descriptive
organisation fields. Replace original anemia fields only in 2020, full join
on organisationunitid and periodcode, and preserve original column order
before appending new fields. Anemia-only rows remain in the report universe.
The anemia period key is cast to the prepared W3 period type before joining.
Period prefix checks and substring extraction cast explicitly to text, matching
R's implicit coercion for numeric `periodcode` inputs without changing their
stored type.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_anemia_fn <- function(archive, member, path) {
  s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(archive, member, function(csv) {
    source <- s4a_diagnosis_csv_fn(csv, "UTF-8")
    columns <- s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(paste("SELECT * FROM", source))
    columns <- setdiff(columns, c("organisationunitcode", "organisationunitdescription"))
    projection <- vapply(columns, function(column) {
      original <- s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(column)
      value <- if (grepl("^org|^period", column)) original else paste0("CAST(nullif(", original, ",'') AS DOUBLE)")
      paste0(value, " AS ", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(gsub("?", "≥", column, fixed = TRUE)))
    }, character(1))
    s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste("SELECT", paste(projection, collapse=","), "FROM", source), path)
  })
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_diagnosis_wave3_anemia_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_anemia_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["anemia"]],
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave3_anemia.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_anemia_correct_fn <- function(w3, anemia, schema, path) {
  source <- s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(w3)
  supplement <- s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(anemia)
  # The prepared W3 CSV reader can infer numeric periods. Match its key type
  # before joining the text-only anemia reader, retaining the W3 output type.
  period_schema <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste(
    "DESCRIBE SELECT periodcode FROM", source
  )) |> dplyr::collect()
  supplement <- paste0("(SELECT * REPLACE (CAST(periodcode AS ",
    period_schema$column_type[[1L]], ") AS periodcode) FROM ", supplement, ")")
  original <- s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(paste("SELECT * FROM", source))
  added <- s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(paste("SELECT * FROM", supplement))
  measurements <- added[!grepl("^org|^period", added)]
  kept <- setdiff(original, c(measurements, "organisationunitid", "periodcode"))
  keys <- c("organisationunitid", "periodcode")
  projection <- c(paste0("coalesce(w.", keys, ",a.", keys, ") AS ", keys),
    paste0("w.", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(kept)),
    paste0("a.", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(measurements)))
  joined <- paste0("SELECT ", paste(projection, collapse=","), " FROM (SELECT * FROM ",
    source, " WHERE starts_with(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),'2020')) w FULL JOIN ", supplement,
    " a ON w.organisationunitid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.organisationunitid ",
    "AND w.periodcode IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.periodcode")
  sql <- paste0("WITH combined AS (SELECT * FROM ", source,
    " WHERE NOT coalesce(starts_with(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),'2020'),false) UNION ALL BY NAME ",
    joined, ") SELECT ", paste(s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(c(original, setdiff(measurements, original))), collapse=","),
    " FROM combined")
  actual <- s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(sql)
  if (!identical(actual, schema$w3_description)) stop("Corrected W3 column order differs from the S3 schema")
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(sql, path)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_diagnosis_wave3_anemia_corrected_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_anemia_correct_fn(
  s0_clinic_RMA_W3_clean_parquet, s4a_diagnosis_wave3_anemia_parquet,
  s3_w3_column_dictionary_df,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave3_anemia_corrected.parquet")
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Deduplicate And Filter Wave 3"}

Rename through the recorded S3 schema, preserving identifiers. Exact-row
deduplication precedes negative repairs, as in 4A; do not deduplicate again
following those repairs. Reporting requires a positive measurement outside
the two refrigerator-temperature columns. The audit records the descriptions
behind all five legacy X references.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_wave3_repair_columns_df <- s3_w3_column_dictionary_df |>
  dplyr::filter(w3_colname %in% c("X1067","X1068","X1736","X1708","X1709"))
s4a_diagnosis_w3_deduplicate_fn <- function(input, schema, path) {
  current <- schema$w3_description
  stopifnot(identical(s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(paste("SELECT * FROM", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input))), current))
  names <- ifelse(grepl("^org|^period", current) | current %in% c("V1","TYPE","FS","code_fs"), current, schema$w3_colname)
  keep <- !names %in% c("V1","TYPE","FS","code_fs")
  projection <- paste0(s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(current[keep]), " AS ", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(names[keep]))
  fixed <- c("X1067","X1068","X1736")
  stopifnot(all(c(fixed,"X1708","X1709") %in% names[keep]))
  repairs <- paste0("CASE WHEN ", fixed, "<0 THEN NULL ELSE ", fixed, " END AS ", fixed)
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("WITH dedup AS (SELECT DISTINCT ", paste(projection,collapse=","),
    " FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input), ") SELECT * REPLACE (", paste(repairs,collapse=","), ") FROM dedup"), path)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_diagnosis_wave3_deduplicated_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_w3_deduplicate_fn(
  s4a_diagnosis_wave3_anemia_corrected_parquet, s3_w3_column_dictionary_df,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave3_deduplicated.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_w3_reporting_fn <- function(input, path) {
  source <- s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input)
  columns <- s4a_diagnosis_columns_fn(paste("SELECT * FROM", source))
  measured <- setdiff(columns[!grepl("^org|^period",columns)], c("X1708","X1709"))
  positive <- paste0("coalesce(", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(measured), ">0,false)")
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("SELECT * FROM ", source, " WHERE list_contains([", paste(positive,collapse=","), "],true)"), path)
}
```

```{r}
  s4a_diagnosis_wave3_deduplicated_parquet,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave3_reporting.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_w3_map_fn <- function(input, rules, path) {
  queries <- lapply(c("wave3A", "wave3B"), function(wave) {
    r <- rules[rules$wave == wave, ]
    projection <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(r)), function(i) paste0(
      s4a_diagnosis_expression_fn(r$terms[[i]], wave), " AS ", s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(r$var[[i]])), character(1))
    paste0("SELECT organisationunitid clinic_ID, try_cast(substr(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),1,4) AS INTEGER) cAnnee, ",
      "try_cast(substr(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),5,2) AS INTEGER) cPeriode, 6::INTEGER fname, ", paste(projection,collapse=","),
      " FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(input), " WHERE ",
      if (wave == "wave3A") "coalesce(starts_with(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),'2020'),false)" else "NOT coalesce(starts_with(CAST(periodcode AS VARCHAR),'2020'),false)")
  })
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste(queries, collapse=" UNION ALL "), path)
}
```

```{r}
  s4a_diagnosis_wave3_reporting_parquet, s4a_diagnosis_evaluation_rules_df,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/wave3_mapped.parquet")
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Select Report Sources Once For All Consumers"}

Selection is report-based, before projecting diagnosis variables. Preserve
candidate multiplicity, prefer the expected file, and otherwise keep every
nearest-distance tie. Only wrong files with an expected alternative belong
to the legacy rejected output. More distant fallbacks get a separate audit
category. Missing join keys use R/data.table missing-key equality.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_candidates_fn <- function(w12, w3, path) {
  paths <- c(w12,w3)
  pieces <- vapply(seq_along(paths), function(i) paste0(
    "SELECT clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname,", i,
    " source_file_order,row_number() OVER () source_row_order FROM ",
    s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(paths[[i]])), character(1))
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("SELECT *,row_number() OVER ",
    "(ORDER BY source_file_order,source_row_order) report_order FROM (",
    paste(pieces,collapse=" UNION ALL "), ")"), path)
}
s4a_diagnosis_selection_sql_fn <- function(source) {
  paste0("WITH expected AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN cAnnee<2015 OR (cAnnee=2015 AND cPeriode<=3) THEN 1 ",
    "WHEN cAnnee IN (2015,2016) THEN 2 WHEN cAnnee=2017 THEN 3 WHEN cAnnee=2018 THEN 4 ",
    "WHEN cAnnee=2019 THEN 5 WHEN cAnnee>2019 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END fname_correct FROM ", source,
    "), distances AS (SELECT *, bool_or(fname=fname_correct) OVER k any_fname_correct, ",
    "abs(fname-fname_correct) fname_dist FROM expected WINDOW k AS (PARTITION BY clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode)), ",
    "ranked AS (SELECT *, min(fname_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode) min_dist FROM distances) ",
    "SELECT *, CASE WHEN fname=fname_correct THEN 'expected' ",
    "WHEN any_fname_correct THEN 'wrong_fname' WHEN fname_dist=min_dist THEN 'nearest_fallback' ",
    "ELSE 'discarded_fallback' END selection FROM ranked")
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_clinic_reporting_candidates_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_candidates_fn(
  s4a_diagnosis_wave12_month_mapped_parquet, s4a_diagnosis_wave3_mapped_parquet,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/reporting_candidates.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_clinic_reporting_selection_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(
  s4a_diagnosis_selection_sql_fn(s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(s4a_clinic_reporting_candidates_parquet)),
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_diagnosis/reporting_selection.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
s4a_report_selection_audit_df <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0(
  "SELECT cAnnee,cPeriode,selection,count(*) reports,count(DISTINCT clinic_ID) clinics FROM ",
  s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(s4a_clinic_reporting_selection_parquet), " GROUP BY ALL")) |> dplyr::collect()
s4a_report_multiplicity_audit_df <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0(
  "SELECT clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,count(*) reports,count(DISTINCT fname) sources FROM ",
  s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(s4a_clinic_reporting_selection_parquet),
  " WHERE selection IN ('expected','nearest_fallback') GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1")) |> dplyr::collect()
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Write The Reporting Tracker"}

The tracker keeps the calendar columns emitted by the retained reports,
in their legacy first-occurrence order (monthly archive order, then W3).
No empty calendar periods are invented. A duplicate clinic/date would make
legacy pivot_wider produce list cells that Feather cannot store. Fail with
the multiplicity audit available; never silently resolve such cases.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_tracker_fn <- function(selection, path) {
  source <- s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(selection)
  retained <- paste0("SELECT *, 'y' || coalesce(CAST(CAST(cAnnee AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR),'NA') || '_m' || coalesce(printf('%02d',CAST(cPeriode AS INTEGER)),'NA') report_date ",
    "FROM ", source, " WHERE selection IN ('expected','nearest_fallback')")
  duplicate <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0("SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT clinic_ID,report_date FROM (",
    retained, ") GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)")) |> dplyr::collect()
  if (duplicate$n > 0) stop("Legacy tracker has non-scalar clinic/date cells; inspect s4a_report_multiplicity_audit_df")
  dates <- s4a_diagnosis_query_fn(paste0("SELECT report_date FROM (",
    retained, ") GROUP BY report_date ORDER BY min(report_order)")) |> dplyr::collect()
  projection <- vapply(dates$report_date, function(date) paste0(
    "coalesce(max(fname) FILTER (WHERE report_date=", s4a_diagnosis_literal_fn(date), "),0)::INTEGER AS ",
    s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(date)), character(1))
  s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0("SELECT clinic_ID", if(length(projection)) paste0(",",paste(projection,collapse=",")),
    " FROM (", retained, ") GROUP BY clinic_ID ORDER BY min(report_order)"), path)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s4a_clinic_reporting_track_parquet <- s4a_diagnosis_tracker_fn(
  s4a_clinic_reporting_selection_parquet,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_reporting_track.parquet")
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Write Retained And Legacy Rejected Diagnosis Groups"}

One branch per ordinary filename selector reads only its V columns.
The two-path return is one file bundle per branch. Distinct selection keys
prevent a join from multiplying measurements; original measurement rows,
including W3 repeated keys with different values, remain intact. Both empty
and nonempty rejected partitions have the same declared schema.

```{r}
s4a_diagnosis_output_fn <- function(group, dictionary, w12, w3, selection, directory) {
  vars <- dictionary$var[!is.na(dictionary$filename) & dictionary$filename == group]
  stopifnot(length(group)==1L, grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", group), length(vars)>0)
  keys <- c("clinic_ID","cAnnee","cPeriode","fname")
  projection <- paste0("m.",s4a_diagnosis_identifier_fn(c(keys,vars)),collapse=",")
  joins <- paste0("m.",keys," IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.",keys,collapse=" AND ")
  sql <- paste0("SELECT ", projection, " FROM ", s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(c(w12,w3)),
    " m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT clinic_ID,cAnnee,cPeriode,fname,selection FROM ",
    s4a_diagnosis_read_fn(selection), ") s ON ", joins)
  retained <- s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0(sql," WHERE s.selection IN ('expected','nearest_fallback')"),
    file.path(directory,paste0(group,".parquet")))
  rejected <- s4a_diagnosis_write_fn(paste0(sql," WHERE s.selection='wrong_fname'"),
    file.path(directory,paste0(group,"_wrong_fname.parquet")))
  c(retained=retained,wrong_fname=rejected)
}
```

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Replication Logic And Graph Boundaries"}

Run synthetic checks before a data build. Tests exercise the notebook helpers
and compare small fixtures to legacy reductions and source selection, without
running targets or collecting scientific measurement tables.

```sh

scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-clinic-diagnosis.R
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-data-storage-convention.R
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-shape-comparison-examples.R
```

For an authorized data build, inspect the duplicate-decision, skipped-subset, dcast-fallback, and source-selection audits,
the retained-report multiplicity audit, and the descriptions of the W3 repair
columns. Compare canonical keys and values to the [most recent archived data](mapping/legacy-pipeline-map.qmd#most-recent-archived-data-comparison-baseline), with
input/dictionary differences recorded explicitly. Load the shared selection
with `dget(here::here("src", "archived-comparison-baseline.R"))`: use its
`archive_zip` with `diagnosis_directory_member` for the ZIP’s May 4
retained/rejected Feather family, `dictionary_member` for its May 3
definitions, and `reporting_tracker_member` for that family’s tracker.
Extract only the members needed for a comparison. All Drive iterations,
including the later May 20 outputs, are excluded from this migration. Historical row counts are
reference points, not unconditional assertions. Measure branch memory/time
before selecting concurrency; this implementation leaves execution serial.
A no-op second build and full-data reference comparison remain data-build
acceptance checks, not claims made by these synthetic tests.

**Current scope (2026-11-08): shape checks are sufficient to continue building.**
The researcher reports that the initial checks on pages 18–21 appear to pass.
Use the following read-only examples after this stage completes. They build
no targets and do not run during rendering. Archived diagnosis partitions
are Feather; their comparison is deferred, with no Feather reader added.
The checks below inspect current Parquet products and their dictionary.
Keep results in the authorized session, outside rendered HTML.

**Load the retained partitions and dictionary.** The `_wrong_fname` files are
rejected reports and are excluded from this retained-output survey.

```r
# Shape check: diagnosis-setup
diagnosis_paths <- unname(targets::tar_read(s4a_diagnosis_output_parquet))
retained_paths <- diagnosis_paths[!grepl("_wrong_fname[.]parquet$", diagnosis_paths)]
stopifnot(length(retained_paths) > 0L, all(file.exists(retained_paths)))
current_dictionary <- targets::tar_read(s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df)
diagnosis_keys <- c("clinic_ID", "cAnnee", "cPeriode", "fname")
```

**Rows, columns, and dictionary agreement for every retained partition.**
Only scalar row counts are collected; column names come from the schema.
Compare each partition's ordered measurement columns to its dictionary group.
A missing or extra partition is listed separately from a column mismatch.

```r
# Shape check: diagnosis-partitions
diagnosis_shapes <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(retained_paths, function(path) {
  relation <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(path, prudence = "stingy")
  partition <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
  measurements <- setdiff(names(relation), diagnosis_keys)
  expected <- current_dictionary$var[!is.na(current_dictionary$filename) & current_dictionary$filename == partition]
  row_count <- relation |> dplyr::summarise(rows = dplyr::n()) |> dplyr::collect()
  tibble::tibble(
    partition = partition, rows = row_count$rows, columns = length(names(relation)),
    key_columns_present = all(diagnosis_keys %in% names(relation)),
    variables = length(measurements), expected_variables = length(expected),
    variable_names_match = setequal(measurements, expected),
    variable_order_matches = identical(measurements, expected)
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::arrange(readr::parse_number(partition))
print(diagnosis_shapes, n = Inf)
tibble::tibble(
  missing_partitions = list(setdiff(unique(current_dictionary$filename), diagnosis_shapes$partition)),
  extra_partitions = list(setdiff(diagnosis_shapes$partition, unique(current_dictionary$filename))),
  repeated_partition_names = list(diagnosis_shapes$partition[duplicated(diagnosis_shapes$partition)])
)
```

**Inspect one partition's schema, clinic-month multiplicity, and calendar.**
Change `partition` to repeat this inspection for another group. A multiplicity
above one is evidence to inspect; do not remove rows to force uniqueness.
Matching partition sizes alone does not prove that their key sets agree.

```r

selected_path <- retained_paths[basename(retained_paths) == paste0(partition, ".parquet")]
stopifnot(length(selected_path) == 1L)
new_diagnosis <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(selected_path, prudence = "stingy")
```
